purpose:
Geometric anchor — orthographic three-view establishing canonical geometry for all subsequent renders.>
urpose
prompt: Technical three-view orthographic drawing of 'VibeFlow', a compact 65% layout input device for creative professionals. Three views arranged horizontally: Front view showing keycap layout with touch strip on left edge, rotary knob top-right, AI key cluster (3 keys) right of spacebar; Side view showing 20mm thickness profile with rounded edge and magnetic expansion port on right side with visible pogo-pin contacts; Top view showing full layout from above. All views maintain consistent geometry: 295mm wide × 110mm deep × 20mm thick, 12mm body corner radius. Creative Coral colorway: coral #E8735A removable shell panels, amber #F5A623 rotary knob, surface #F2EDE8 matte keycap area, graphite #4A464D keycap sides. Low-profile rounded keycaps with subtle dish. Dimension annotations in monospace font showing key measurements. Clean technical drawing style with soft shadows, warm neutral background #F2EDE8. Labels 'Front', 'Side', 'Top' in geometric sans-serif medium weight.
negative_prompt: perspective view, isometric, gaming aesthetics, RGB lighting, pure white background, pure black background, dark moody lighting, transparent case, neural-net graphics, aggressive angles
